senses.gloss: भण्डूक bhaṇḍ-ūka, m. a kind of fish.
भाण bhāṇa, m. kind of play: i-kā, f. id..
भाण्डापुर bhāṇḍā-pura, n. N. of a town.

भाण्डारिक bhāṇḍār-ika, m. superintendent 🞄of a store, treasurer;
 -in, a. id..

भाण्डीर bhāṇḍīra, m. N. of a large Nyagrodha 🞄tree on the Govardhana;
 N. of a Dānava.
